prerequisites: ready VDD knowledge context bound to current main

slices.behavior: Publish the legacy authority closure, active-entrypoint census, and R4 relocation mapping without changing durable review semantics.
slices.red_or_legacy: Legacy regression: current repository Bootstrap whole-directory validation and 7-12 compatibility validation pass before migration edits.
slices.green: The census and relocation contract pass targeted migration tests while implementation-contract.v1 remains non-authoritative.
slices.recovery: Disable the new census consumer and retain the current repository Bootstrap owner plus old compatibility adapter.

slices.behavior: Project a non-authorizing baseline-informed complete finding-mode re-entry recommendation.
slices.red_or_legacy: RED: current CLI has no deterministic recommendation producer and accepts caller-supplied recommendation fields only.
slices.green: Detached tests cover recommend, do-not-recommend, missing cohort, stale lineage, stale calibration, trigger mismatch, and explicit-confirmation preservation.
slices.recovery: Remove the projection entrypoint; existing explicit re-entry authorization remains available with its current contract.

slices.behavior: Promote and roll back reviewed Bootstrap cost calibrations through versioned repository references.
slices.red_or_legacy: RED: build-review-baseline emits candidates and runtime consumes one static reference, but no bounded promotion/rollback workflow exists.
slices.green: Detached promotion, substitution, incompatible predecessor, fallback, retained-run-binding, and rollback tests pass.
slices.recovery: Select the last retained compatible reference or conservative fallback; never delete candidate or historical bindings.

slices.behavior: Apply thin Bootstrap delegation only after a declared high-risk Toolchain caller selects complete semantic review, then run one terminal migration replay across Bootstrap, Acceptance, legacy 7-12, and relocated 7-11 plan contracts.
slices.red_or_legacy: RED: census fixture contains an unclassified or direct high-risk semantic-review caller; low-risk fixture is incorrectly forced into complete finding mode.
slices.green: All entrypoints are classified, selected high-risk complete-review routes delegate, low-risk routes remain unchanged, and terminal replay passes without BMAD/GDS, Catalog, TC-D1, TC-D2, TC-D3, TC-D6, or Phase product changes.
slices.recovery: Disable selective routing additions independently, preserve existing Bootstrap and Acceptance routes, and keep R4 paused in 7-11.
